Class DeckTemplate

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.factory.DeckTemplate
public final class DeckTemplate extends Object
Immutable catalog of card blueprints loaded from the static deck JSON.

The template stores suppliers instead of concrete card instances so that each match receives independent objects, while the expensive JSON parsing happens only once during server lifetime.
